capabilities: Create and manage event notes on a calendar by date
Open markdown files as kanban boards and add lists from the command palette
Create linked notes and events from kanban cards with synced backlinks
Review dated kanban-linked events in timeline and year-based Gantt views
Remove linked notes and events when deleting a card
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The References section mentions plugins that inspired it but does not name them.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan and review dated work across a kanban board, calendar, timeline, and board-level schedule in one connected workflow.
summary: Planning plugin that combines calendar, timeline, kanban board, and Gantt views with linked notes and event notes created from kanban cards.
